_closed_set: scripts/f13_code_full_draw.py line 87 stamps coder_model into every row (the [925]-era fix). These nine artifacts PREDATE it; nothing produced since carries the gap. This deposit is a backfill, not a policy.
_hk_note: HK resolves to claude-haiku-4-5 at 97.2% (n=2,077) against 86.3% for the nearest rival, which is decisive — but it is NOT identity. 58 rows differ. The stash is append-mode and a read returns the LATEST value, so a re-run key would diverge from what the file recorded. That is the likely cause and it is NOT verified. Recorded rather than smoothed.
_legend_provenance: THE SUFFIX LEGEND IS RECOVERED FROM EVIDENCE, NOT FROM THE FILENAME CONVENTION. The task HashStash records the model string per entry. Item coverage CANNOT discriminate — every coder coded the same items by design — so the v5 legend was resolved by VALUE IDENTITY: for each file, the fraction of rows whose relation_primary equals that model's stash value. Four of five resolve at 100.0%; HK at 97.2% (see _hk_note).
_no_receipt: None of these runs asserted reasoning_tokens == 0. Registration P's producer does, on every call. These nine files have no receipt at all.
_rule: THE NINE FILES ARE NOT INTERCHANGEABLE CODERS. Any statistic pooling across them inherits a MIXTURE OF SAMPLING REGIMES: DeepSeek uncontrolled (silent), OpenAI and Haiku controlled, Sonnet temperature-rejecting (visible). Pool only with the mixture stated.
_two_failure_shapes: They must never be swapped. DEEPSEEK ACCEPTS-AND-IGNORES: no error, invisible to any dropped-parameter audit, indistinguishable from a working pin. SONNET REJECTS: a 400, reported, which is why it could be recorded. One announces itself; the other is what a working pin looks like.
_what: Provenance and sampling-control record for the nine F13 multi-coder artifacts (five v5 relation codings, four intensity rankings).
_why_this_file_exists: These parquets carry NO coder column, NO model column, NO temperature field and no file metadata beyond ARROW:schema and pandas — the coder identity lives in the FILENAME and nowhere else. A caveat bound to the claims register protects only the reader who arrives via the claim. Authorized by the pen, docket [4178].2, extended to nine files at [4181].
